title: Flutter Security Scanner config (.fshrc.yaml / .fshrc.yml / .fshrc.json)
description: Project-local tuning for the scanner: rules to disable, severity remaps, path globs, defaults for --fail-on, and engine budgets. CLI flags always override this file.

rules.description: Per-rule overrides keyed by rule code. Use boolean shorthand to enable/disable, a string for the severity, or an object for fine control.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (gitignore-shaped) excluded from the scan. Matched against project-relative POSIX paths. Wildcards: `*`, `**`, `?`. A pattern with no wildcard matches as a path prefix (e.g. `build` matches `build/main.dart`).

fail_on.description: Default --fail-on threshold when the CLI flag isn't supplied. Useful for codifying the team's CI gate.

include_suggestions.description: Default for --no-suggestions. When false, heuristic suggestions are dropped from the report.

max_file_size.description: Per-file size cap. Files above the limit are skipped with a warning and reported in the scan stats. `0` disables the cap. Default: 1MB.

rule_timeout.description: Per-rule wall-clock budget. A rule that exceeds this is aborted and a `scanner-internal-error` finding is emitted. `0` disables. Default: 30s.

ruleCode.description: Rule identifier, kebab-case. Unknown codes do not error (for forward compat with rules added in newer scanner versions), but typos silently no-op — copy from the docs.

severity.description: Severity level. `error/warning/note/info` are SARIF-style aliases for `high/medium/low/low`.

oneOf.description: true = enabled (default), false = disable rule entirely.
Shorthand: `off`/`disabled` to disable, or a severity (`high|medium|low|error|warning|note|info`) to remap severity.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable this rule.

severity.description: Remap this rule's severity. Use sparingly — silencing a HIGH usually means the path should be excluded instead.

exclude.description: Glob patterns; findings from this rule whose file matches are dropped. Use this rather than severity:low to silence noisy paths.

oneOf.description: An empty entry (`my-rule:`) is a no-op, not a disable.
